status: PROSPECTIVE POLICY ONLY; ORIGINAL RUN ACTIVE; NO EXPORT OR INFERENCE ADMISSION
declaration_timing: Declared after observing checkpoint-512 development losses and integrity, while original training was still active, before new candidate export or Colibri generation and before any natural terminal event.

allowed_trigger.cause: The pinned supervisor naturally raises subprocess.TimeoutExpired for its unchanged bound training command at 28*3600 seconds.
must_preserve: Actual terminal unit status, journal and supervisor traceback
Original launch anchors, logs and unmodified artifacts
Evidence that original trainer/controller are stopped and the owned cgroup is empty
must_reject: Changed source, dataset, base model or framework provenance
Unexplained failure or failure cause not matching the pinned child timeout

requirements: Preserve a stable terminal read-only snapshot before model work.
Verify all original launch, data, source, base-model and dependency hashes.
Verify the complete finite contiguous update prefix and planned row order through each candidate step.
Require a complete matching development-validation record for each candidate, including finite per-application losses.
Verify stable adapter/config hashes in repeated read-only observations, expected LoRA names/shapes, all finite tensor values and complete payload layout.
Preserve and match every independently recorded checkpoint observation; checkpoint 512 must retain its already-recorded adapter hash.
Inventory every original scheduled checkpoint, final output, selected alias and partial artifact with explicit eligibility or exclusion reasons.
Never silently exclude a previously validated checkpoint that is missing, changed or corrupt; halt for investigation.
A not-yet-reached checkpoint or a save/validation interrupted at the natural cutoff may be excluded only with preserved evidence.
Freeze and review the entire eligible candidate list and terminal evidence before any candidate export or generation.
eligibility.export_or_evaluation_failure_policy: Halt and preserve evidence; never remove a declared eligible candidate to continue ranking.

selection: lowest recorded Facturation validation semantic loss
selection_loss_source: Per-checkpoint Facturation semantic validation loss from the complete recorded history; the generic selector field is validation_macro_loss.

post_selection.critical_and_clarification_cases: Every critical proposed-change and clarification case must match; all existing subset and per-application gates remain required.
post_selection.retained_application_development_metrics: No decline from original checkpoint 600 in tools, valid structures, full actions or eligible exact arguments.

baseline_winner_behavior: Retain the baseline prior failed acceptance; do not claim a new accepted model.
required_separate_controls: A natural-timeout terminal collector and immutable evidence inventory.
A new binding to actual eligible adapters, source/runtime/provider hashes, export artifacts and complete evidence.
Reviewed one-shot export/evaluation controls, negative admission tests and owned-worker cleanup.
The unchanged 133-case development ranking and every unchanged downstream acceptance, retained-application, native security and activation gate.
limitations: This protocol does not satisfy or replace the published successful 3103-update completion protocol.
Interrupted training must remain explicitly incomplete; never synthesize a successful completion report or use the original successful-run driver with fabricated evidence.
The declared candidate subset is based only on complete artifact/validation evidence, not observed functional or acceptance results.
Original cases, labels, provider, scorer, thresholds and historical scores remain unchanged.
Development and regression safeguards have been inspected repeatedly; they are not fresh blind statistical certification.
Passing the three retained-application test scopes cannot establish all-six-app acceptance or replace actual native permission/security tests.
Preparation does not predict 95 percent accuracy, authorize a restart, or admit model inference, activation or subsequent training.
